svg.title: The Binance book before a top-taker fire, a look-alike our model scores the same, and an ordinary moment
svg.desc: Three columns of three panels: best-level sizes, aggressive trades and the Binance mid change, from -1000 to +300 ms around each moment.
svg.text: Binance futures best level, 1 s before to 0.3 s after each moment; far side = the bid (must empty for a move their way).
